question: Who among the following was the founder of the Bahmani Sultanate, who took the title of Bahman Shah after his accession to the throne?
solution:
The correct answer is __Alauddin Hasan__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bahmani kingdom was established by **Alauddin Bahman Shah** in 1347 AD.
 
• He was also known as Hasan Gangu__.
 
• It was the first independent Muslim kingdom in South India.
 
• He was a Turkish officer of Devagiri.
 
• The Kingdom included the areas of Deccan up to river Krishna and the capital of this kingdom was Gulbarga.
 
• The rulers of this dynasty gave special emphasis on education.
 
• They encouraged Persian and Arabic learning and during this period Urdu flourished.
 
• They build several Madrasa, mosques, and libraries.
 
• The famous monuments built by them are Jama Masjid at Gulbarga, Golconda Fort, Gol Gumbaz at Bijapur, and Madarsa of Mohammed Gawan.
 
• The rulers of this dynasty were buried in A beautiful tomb complex known as Bahmani tombs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• In **1463 A.D. Muhammad Shah lll** became the Sultan at the age of nine
 
• Muhammad Gawan became the regent of the infant ruler.
 
• Under Muhammad Gawan’s able leadership the Bahmani kingdom became very powerful.
 
• Muhammad Gawan improved the administration, systematized finances, encouraged public education, reformed the revenue system, disciplined the army, and eliminated corruption.
